reading: Support, viewpoints and range passed; purity (0.267 < 0.6) and misses (3 > 0.34 x 4) failed. The detector boxes for countertop and kitchen cabinet span the whole counter run, so depth back-projection fuses cabinet, counter and sink points into one 3D track whose label share is mostly cabinet and countertop (4 of 15 views say sink); the true sink footprint centre is (-2.08,0.39) and the track centre (-2.53,1.52) lies about 1.1 m beyond it.
